name: Guangzhou Yousu 3D Technology Co., Ltd. (广州优塑三维科技有限公司)
summary: Guangzhou manufacturer (YOUSU / 优塑) with a production base in Zengcheng District, selling budget PLA variants (matte, silk, rainbow, PLA+), engineering filaments (PETG, ABS+, TPU 95A, PP, PP-CF, PVA) plus resins and 3D pens, mainly via Amazon US. Presents as its own-brand extruder (TCT Asia 2024 exhibitor); no OEM or YASIN 3D relationship found.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Spools 250 g to 5 kg; 5 kg PLA ~$12.5-13/kg.

product_lines.name: Co-extrusion PLA
product_lines.notes: Co-extruded multi-colour PLA; finish not specified, so no silk/gradient id asserted.

product_lines.name: Conductive filament
product_lines.notes: Base polymer not stated; no conductive id exists in the catalog.

additional_notes: Company claims (founded c.2013, ISO 9001, 30-mu production base) come from a sponsored exhibitor article on shifair.com and are self-reported. Searches for YASIN return separate entities (YASIN 3D Technology Co., Ltd.; Hunan Yasin Technology) with no link to Yousu. No first-party website, docs or social accounts identified; sold on Amazon US.

provenance.conflicts: Corporate claims are from a sponsored exhibitor article; no official site or registry record read.
